name: enterprise-deal-reconciler
description: Reconciles an enterprise contract or order form with its billing setup before the first invoice goes out. Reads the contract from your documents (or pasted text), extracts the commercial terms with a verbatim quote for each (seats, unit price, discount, currency, start and end dates, term, billing frequency, payment terms, auto-renewal), reads the customer's subscription, schedule, prices and coupons from your payments account, and compares them field by field in code with fixed tolerances. Returns mismatches[] with severity (critical, high, medium), the computed delta and the exact fix to make, plus what was verified, what the contract does not state, and a verdict (clean, review, blocked). Read-only: never changes billing and writes nothing anywhere.

skills.name: Reconcile a contract with billing
skills.description: Contract terms vs the customer's billing setup, field by field: mismatches with severity, delta and the exact fix, what was verified, what the contract leaves unstated, and a clean / review / blocked verdict.
